inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The per-session request store used by the service. request and cancel read records with get and replace them with put only when the expected revision matches; this service does not call list.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.constructor.catalog
inputs.description: Provides configured picker models through list(). status exposes that list, and request accepts only a provider/model present in it with an effort in that model's efforts list.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.constructor.control
inputs.description: Optional desktop session control used by status to inspect a truthy session ID and set controlConnected. This service does not call resume or apply a provider switch; when omitted, active is null and the unavailable message is used.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.status.sessionId
inputs.description: An optional explicit Codex session ID to validate, inspect when control is available, and use to retrieve its request. Defaults to null; truthy values must be 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.request.sessionId
inputs.description: The explicit Codex session ID whose switch request is being queued. It must be 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.request.target
inputs.description: The provider/model/effort selection to queue. Provider must be openai or harness-claude, and the catalog must contain the provider/model with the requested effort in its efforts list.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.cancel.sessionId
inputs.description: The explicit Codex session ID whose current request is being cancelled. It must be 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.cancel.requestId
inputs.description: The ID of the request expected to be cancelled. IDs created by this service are UUIDs, and cancellation succeeds only when this ID matches the session's current pending request.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.status
outputs.description: The resolved picker snapshot for the requested session context, including catalog models and desktop-control availability. A null or empty session ID omits session-specific lookup; active is also null whenever control is absent.

examples.message: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.request
outputs.description: The resolved picker snapshot after a target is catalog-validated and stored as a pending request. Requests remain pending for desktop verification; this service does not change provider settings.

request.reason: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

examples.message: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitchService.cancel
outputs.description: The resolved picker snapshot after the current pending request is marked cancelled with reason Cancelled by the user. It does not change provider settings.

examples.message: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error is thrown for invalid session IDs, unavailable catalog selections or efforts, an applying prior request, cancellation of anything other than the current pending request, or a failed revision-checked store write. Errors from catalog, store, and session-control calls also propagate.
